title: SBSymbol
description: resource pack that changes hypixel skyblock arachnal symbol from Ж to spider emoji
body:
resource pack that changes hypixel skyblock arachnal symbol from Ж to spider emoji

there's 2 versions try both or take a look at the screenshots

The texture pack was originally made for personal use, because I was tired of seeing the letter Ж on spiders. But I decided to share the texture pack with people, in case there are many others like me.

the only difference between v1 and v2 is the appearance of the spider icon, so take a look at the screenshots to see which one suits you better
